help: Number of GPU expert slots per layer; zero uses the native memory-fitting policy.
GPU memory budget for routed experts, in GiB.
Rows processed by the native hybrid expert path.
Enable MTP verification with multiple native decode slots.
Limit draft proposals to the first N token IDs.

batched prompt processing in chunks of CHUNK tokens (needs --native); auto = the largest chunk up to 8192 whose buffers the expert cache can lend; auto:16384 / auto:32768 (or STRATA_PREFILL_AUTO_MAX) allow bigger ones

R2.2: CPU expert pool worker count.  Default 0 = every physical core except the one the host loop spins on (with --pool-affinity auto or p-cores on a hybrid CPU: P-cores minus 1).  A sweep is how the pool's deviation from `cpu_s2` is attributed.

--serve (opt-in): up to N requests decode together in batch slots (2..8 normally; --batch-mtp waves more through eight-row windows), each slot with its own session (VRAM like the main one); docs/BATCHING.md
--serve takes images too (GENI requests; embeddings from strata-vision)
